abstract: Evaluates locomotive traction on steep grades, emergency thermal armor, and train propulsion dynamics
system_message:
You are Rolling stock engineering lead (RSA). The Rolling stock engineering lead (RSA) evaluates locomotive traction on steep grades, emergency thermal armor, and train propulsion dynamics, alongside monitoring acoustic emissions during portal approaches.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic emission assessment（NOISE）
information_points.content:
RSA-NOISE-09A：For the Tri-mode battery-electric intervention convoy, the portal approach acoustic emission is 74 dB measured as the peak equivalent continuous sound level at 25 meters during maximum acceleration.
RSA-NOISE-SDD：For the Bi-directional twin-cab diesel rescue shuttle, the portal approach acoustic emission is 68 dB measured as the peak equivalent continuous sound level at 25 meters during maximum acceleration.
RSA-NOISE-BZN：For the Catenary-independent sealed-hull rescue consist, the portal approach acoustic emission is 82 dB measured as the peak equivalent continuous sound level at 25 meters during maximum acceleration.

information_points.title: Evaluates locomotive traction on steep grades, emergency thermal armor, and train propulsion dynamics（PROP）
information_points.content:
RSA-PROP-ZJJ：For the Bi-directional twin-cab diesel rescue shuttle, gradient starting traction is verified on the maximum 28 permille adverse gradient inside the alpine tunnel with a full trailing passenger load, and the continuous thermal shielding rating of the exterior carriage body shell and window glazing assemblies is 350 deg C sustained for 60 minutes.
RSA-PROP-V2J：For the Catenary-independent sealed-hull rescue consist, gradient starting traction is not verified on the maximum 28 permille adverse gradient inside the alpine tunnel with a full trailing passenger load, while its continuous thermal shielding rating is 300 deg C sustained for 60 minutes across the exterior carriage body shell and window glazing assemblies.
RSA-PROP-M1W：For the Tri-mode battery-electric intervention convoy, gradient starting traction is verified on the maximum 28 permille adverse gradient inside the alpine tunnel with a full trailing passenger load, and its continuous thermal shielding rating reaches 300 deg C sustained for 60 minutes across the exterior carriage body shell and window glazing assemblies.
